children: China's urban unemployment rate for youths rose to 18.9% in August, the worst reading since August 2025 and up from 17.9% in July, data released by the National Bureau of Statistics showed on Thursday.
The group consists of 16- to 24-year-olds, excluding students.
For people aged 25 to 29, the unemployment rate was 7.5%, up from 7.2% in July. The rate for 30- to-59-year-olds was unchanged from July, at 3.9%.
